title: The Storm Archive
description: An original floating observatory gathering the stories that weather leaves behind.
hero: Every storm leaves something worth keeping.

sections.title: Above the noise.
sections.body: Three copper rings hold a living archive above the storm sea. Inside, warm light falls on the traces of worlds that would otherwise disappear.

cards.title: Listen
cards.body: The archive begins with attention: rain, distant thunder, a voice carried across water.

cards.title: Preserve
cards.body: Every collected object keeps its origin. The story is as important as the shape.

cards.title: Return
cards.body: An archive becomes useful when someone can find their way back to it.

sections.title: Come with questions.
sections.body: This is a demonstration of an original fictional campaign, not an operating visitor attraction.

faqs.question: What can I explore here?
faqs.answer: The setting and its creative idea. This example uses real browser navigation and disclosures.

faqs.question: Where are the film and images?
faqs.answer: They have not been generated. The production plan can guide that work without presenting placeholders as finished footage.
